_comentario: Cole o bloco 'headers' dentro do seu vercel.json. Ajuste a CSP aos dominios que o app realmente usa. Comece a CSP em Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, valide, depois troque para Content-Security-Policy.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://res.cloudinary.com; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://firestore.googleapis.com https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests
